scope: Audit only. No repair code and no production database changes.

findings.message: Backup data collector exports whole selected table rows without explicit redaction allowlist. Keep encrypted, but add a future redaction manifest before target 94-96.
Run-now response returns a signed URL directly. Acceptable for Super Admin workflow, but future target should require approval/download audit step.
Legacy backup schedule route uses wildcard permission for POST. Prefer canonical /api/admin/backups/schedules with write:settings.
Legacy backup API appears to use older backup_jobs columns/RPC. Keep disabled from UI or retire/redirect to /api/admin/backups/jobs.

recommendation: No blocking P0. Create V28.6.8.1 focused hardening for legacy route cleanup, redaction manifest, and download approval before target 94-96.
